card.name: Digits in dosing interval tables
card.fires_on: The final digit or part of a dosing interval number, such as the 4 in "every 24 hours" or the 2 in "every 12 hours", inside dosing tables. It also fires on a few similar spots such as BID and 48 hours.

modes.label: Interval hours digit
modes.description: The last digit of an hours interval after "every" in a dose table.
modes.example: Dosage and Duration of Therapy in Adult Patients Type of Infection a Dose Every 2<<4>> hours Duration b (days) Community Ac

modes.label: Frequency or dose cell
modes.description: A frequency abbreviation or number inside a weight-based dosing table.

modes.label: Stray option words
modes.description: Odd words in option phrases outside tables, such as "same" in "Resume at same dose".
modes.example: Resume at<< same>> dose or reduced dose, as clinically appropriate

card.writes: It has no clear link to its promoted tokens, but it suppresses "or" and "either" words, so it may reduce alternative-style wording after the number.
card.plain: It fires on the number in a dosing schedule, such as the 4 in "every 24 hours", mostly in dose tables.
